- 4 stars, Nov 2025: -Authentic Japanese food is provided here ( Keep in mind that there are very less vegetarian options available here ) -Staff were very polite and helpful. -Service was swift and proper. -Options are there to sit on chairs and eat or for a more authentic experience, sit in a Seiza position and eat ( slippers/shoes must be removed before entering the booth ). -A lot of the patrons here seem to be Japanese ppl and they all seem to know each other, which further solidifies the fact that the food served here is very good. -I would recommend getting a reservation before going here. -Parking for cars might be a bit difficult since the restaurant is located in a residential street and on the first floor of what seems to be an apartment. - I would also recommend coming here with a group (atleast 3-4 people), as the dishes provided here are meant to be shared.
- 5 stars, Oct 2025: Rare to find such perfectly done tempura, the miso was healing, and the quality of tuna exceptional, loved the maki. Thank you, Team Oyama, for a wonderful experience.
- 5 stars, Oct 2025: Excellent Japanese comfort food! We started with the salmon hosomaki sushi, which had the most delightful texture — the seaweed wrap melded perfectly with the fresh salmon. Next came the salmon ura roll, where salmon, Japanese omelette, and caviar came together in delectable harmony. The prawn tempura was incredibly crunchy with juicy shrimp inside, while the chicken teriyaki stood out for its rich, flavourful sauce and tender meat. We also tried the Japanese udon noodles with beef and the beef katsu don; however, the beef was rather dry and chewy, and the quality and tenderness left much to be desired. That said, the lacklustre beef dishes were completely eclipsed by the spectacular pork katsu rice set meal, served with miso soup and sticky Japanese rice. The pork was perfectly cooked — crunchy on the outside, yet juicy, saucy, and melt-in-the-mouth on the inside. It was the highlight of the entire meal, an absolute flavour bomb that left us thoroughly satisfied. To top it off, the bill was a pleasant surprise — excellent value for money and very reasonable pricing for such a wide variety of authentic Japanese dishes. Will definitely visit again to try more from their menu!
- 5 stars, Aug 2025: Had gone with my family for lunch. We started with Miso soup which was exactly how I remember it tasted in Tokyo during my stay there. The Cheese Fry was lovely and felt like it was made fresh, quite unlike the standard frozen mozzarella cheese sticks one finds in the multi cuisine restaurants in Chennai. We also had Buta Shoga Yaki (a form of grilled pork), Beef Katsu Don (beef cutlets in sticky rice) and Gyu Niku Udon (Grilled beef in soupy Udon noodles broth). All of these were exceptionally tasty! We ended with Matcha pudding which was the only thing that I'd rate as average, and I'd solely attribute that to matcha being an acquired taste, which I've not acquired. 🙂 Overall a wonderful experience!
- 4 stars, Jun 2025: Being a fan of Japan and its diverse food and culture, decided to visit “Oyama Japanese Restaurant” and have an experience of our own. The food was outstanding and of adequate quantity. The atmosphere and ambience was good. Quiet and light music. The staff’s could have been even more welcoming and pleasant. But nonetheless, an overall good restaurant with many food options and quality food and easy for beginners or people who want to try Japanese food for first time. For lunch - opens from 11:30 am to 2:30 pm. Overall experience - 4/5. ⭐️
- 5 stars, Apr 2025: Absolutely loved the place, it has a great atmosphere that helps you relax, the style of the restaurant is like a typical Japanese restaurant, the service is good, could be better compared to the service provided in Japan, but it's better than other restaurants, the options of food available is surprising, it took me some time to choose, but the food taste delicious and has adequate quality and quantity which you'll feel happy and full. You should visit the place atleast once, you'll love it if you are interested in Japanese food and culture.
- 4 stars, Dec 2024: The food was beautiful overall, it was my first time having authentic Japanese food and I enjoyed it throughly. A huge shoutout for the tempura section. It was the exact light and crisp it needed. Enjoyed. Some of the other dishes that stood out for us were, the sushi and the ginger beef. However, I left feeling somewhat disappointed with the overall experience. The service staff was constantly rushing us to finish up our meal and seemed a little rude. Couldn’t try their deserts as they didn’t have them available towards the end.
- 5 stars, Sep 2024: One of the best Japanese restaurants in Chennai! The food is delicious, the hospitality is excellent, and the ambience is amazing. It’s on the pricier side, but definitely worth trying once in a while. Plus, the meal comes with complimentary black tea. Don’t miss out on the Tori Katsu Don and Tempura—both are must-tries!
